label: miso 74 manitoba seam
definition: MISO KEEPER (promoted 2026-07-18). NOT-YET, 2 fails — down from miso-72's 3: C1 fuelmix FAIL→PASS (all 16/16 in band; CC_REGULAR-2023 −8.33→−7.23 TWh into band), C3b veto held & improved (0.181-2025 vs 0.183), C3a −0.8/−6.7/−13.3% (toward actual every year); the 2 remaining fails {C3a-2025, C3c} are the irreducible scarcity tail. Mechanism: the import-only annual-flat Manitoba (MHEB) firm block replaced by a fourth MEASURED two-way priced seam — the frozen Q-Q ladder MISO_SEAM_LADDER_BY_YEAR['Manitoba'] + the measured two-way MHEB deliverability envelope, the same machinery as PJM/SPP/South (ScenarioConfig.miso_manitoba_seam). 2025 realizes the measured net export (−0.38 vs block +1.96; measured −0.99) the flat block cannot; per-seam duration RMSE improves every year and hourly correlation is restored (nan→+0.5-0.67). Zero fitted scalars (retires the 3 firm-block MW values). The total net-interchange DIAGNOSTIC worsens — the rule-14/11 honest exposure of the priced-seam (PJM/South) under-import the block was masking, the merit-cap composition lane. Charter: docs/handoffs/miso-manitoba-seam-design-2026-07.md.
market_story: imports (Manitoba): the MISO–Manitoba tie is a scheduled two-way seasonal hydro exchange — freshet/summer import, winter export to winter-peaking Manitoba, net export in the 2025 drought — not spot-spread arbitrage; the measured Q-Q ladder + two-way deliverability envelope reproduce that revealed schedule (the import-only flat firm block had no export path and over-imported). CC_REGULAR: MISO gas-CC recovers into band because the flat firm block was over-importing (+1–3 TWh/yr vs measured) and displacing it — removing the wrong over-import lets domestic CC serve the load it was ceding (rule 11: the estimate was silently compensating a CC deficit).
